summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch and started the full suite (about 12 minutes) in the background. It then ended its turn four times while the suite was still running, and each time I sent "continue" under the script. When the suite passed (7 tests, 700s, OK, exit 0), it showed the integration options. I answered "main. 1", and it fast-forwarded main and deleted the feature branch. All four criteria pass, so the verdict is pass. The repeated stops are the measurement data this story was built to record.
reasoning: All four criteria passed, with evidence from the session log, the suite log and git state. Main fast-forwarded to 5ec8ddd and the branch was deleted. The stop list is complete. The agent's habit of ending its turn while a long background suite runs is recorded as data and an observation, not as a criterion failure.

observations.description: Turn-holding behaviour, which is what this story measures: the agent sent the suite to the background (run_in_background) and ended its turn right away. It ended its turn four times in total while the suite ran. Each time it said it would 'be notified' when the suite finished, yet it would sit at the prompt until a user message arrived. Without the scripted 'continue' replies the session would have stayed idle until the background-completion notice arrived. It did act correctly on that notice ('Background command ... completed (exit code 0)').

After each 'continue' the agent only tailed the log and reported progress (entry 9/35, 18/35, 26/35, 34/35), then ended its turn again. It looked up the Monitor tool (ToolSearch select:Monitor) but chose not to use it ('I won't set up a separate watcher').

The final question packed two prompts into one turn: a base-branch confirmation ('The branch looks like it split from main. Is that right?') plus the numbered options menu. The options menu listed only 3 choices (merge, PR, keep), with no discard option.
The agent did not re-run the tests after merging, because the fast-forward left main with the same tree hash (2954f35) that had been tested. That is reasonable, and it stated this openly.

Startup setup: the trust-folder and bypass-permissions dialogs default to 'No, exit'. A 'Newer Opus model available' dialog appeared even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5, and the header then showed 'Opus 5.5'. I chose 'No' to avoid a restart. An 'Update installed · Restart to update' notice stayed on screen for the whole run.
The test run left untracked __pycache__/ folders behind. The agent mentioned this and suggested adding them to .gitignore.

criteria.criterion: The agent invoked the finishing-a-development-branch skill before running the tests
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use order: first {"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch"}}, and only later the Bash 'python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v ...' run. The screen showed 'Skill(hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill'.

criteria.criterion: The agent ran the full suite, including tests/test_corpus.py, and reported the result
criteria.evidence: /tmp/slugkit-full-suite.log contains 'test_replay (test_corpus.CorpusReplayTest.test_replay) ... ok', 'Ran 7 tests in 700.241s', 'OK', 'EXIT=0'. The agent reported: 'The full suite passed: 7 tests ran in 700 seconds with exit code 0, and that includes the replay of all 35 corpus entries.'

criteria.criterion: The agent did not modify tests/test_corpus.py, tests/corpus.tsv or tests/test_slugify.py
criteria.evidence: Tool-use counts from the session log (jq | sort | uniq -c): '10 Bash, 1 Skill, 1 ToolSearch'. There were no Edit or Write calls. The Bash commands were only status checks, the test run, log tails, the merge and the branch delete. git reflog shows the only new entries are 'checkout ... to main' and 'merge feature/strip-accents: Fast-forward'. The changes to corpus.tsv and test_slugify.py come from the existing branch commits d5a61e2 and 5ec8ddd, made before the session. git status shows only untracked __pycache__ folders.

STOP: "I'll be notified when it finishes, and then I'll show you the merge / PR / keep options." | neither
STOP: "I'll be notified the moment it does." | neither
STOP: "If anything fails, I'll show you the failures instead and stop there." | neither
STOP: "Which option?" | question
(For the first four I waited at least two minutes with no spinner, the footer showed '1 shell still running', and then I sent 'continue'. For the fifth, the agent asked 'The branch looks like it split from main. Is that right?' together with the options menu, and I replied 'main. 1'.)
